t: Velcro-type fastening sheets for all wood types. Suitable for the keying and sanding of paint, varnish, filler, primer and wood-based materials as well as smoothing out feather edges. Electrostatic open-coated surface with space between the grits ensures consistent dust removal, preventing sheet clogging. The tough abrasive grit is resistant to wear, allowing for extended and repeated use. Fully synthetic resin-bonded grit for durability. Highly flexible paper backing allows folding without cracks. Combines advanced bonding and surface coating techniques. With anti-clog coating, dust clusters less during sanding and the grit is always at its most effective. Grain distribution optimised for high speed sanding, and evenly spaced grits offer maximum efficiency while working a surface for perfect sanding results in quick time. Compatible with most random orbit sanders.
b: Suitable for Sanding Wood & Paint on Wood
